rubric.text: Launches the reviewer with `run_in_background: false` because a subagent receives no completion notifications, waits for the verdict in the same turn, and does not hand back `pending` while its own reviewer runs; `pending` names only remote or controller-owned gates.
Pushes only after a `ship` verdict covers the exact clean head `e5f0`; routes any finding back to the owner for repair and renewed review, and leaves merge and Project state to the controller.
